page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr6.20xlarge is a memory-optimized instance powered by the x86_64 architecture. It features 80 dedicated physical cores with 80 vCPUs, utilizing Intel Xeon 8269CY processors running at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The instance is configured with 768.0 GB of RAM, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 9.6 GB per core. It operates on the KVM hypervisor, ensuring dedicated CPU allocation without hyperthreading, as threads per core is set to 1.0.

For connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 25 Gbps. A key architectural tradeoff is the complete absence of local storage, requiring external block storage solutions for any data persistence. Additionally, there are no integrated GPUs, making this instance unsuitable for hardware-accelerated graphics or deep learning training workloads.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.hfr6.20xlarge offers a high-density memory configuration relative to its compute resources, making it a viable option for memory-bound workloads without the overhead of GPU hardware. It is designed for large-scale databases, in-memory caching systems, enterprise resource planning applications, and intensive data processing tasks that require substantial RAM but do not rely on local disk I/O.
